attribution: ©IGN,BDTopo via Geoplateforme WFS. Modified by a bounded geographic query, overlap exclusion, numeric source-height registration and original facade/roof reconstruction.
height_source: Per-feature actual altitudes/height/number_d_etages and source precision retained in original response. Some values derive from photogrammetry/cadastre/correlation and different survey dates; not a new engineering survey.
vertical_registration: Source metric ground/eaves/roof altitudes minus the existing RGE scenery-ground.json relative datum; no terrain or native-road rescale.
roof_method: Retain actual footprint, floorcount where supplied, numeric eaves/ridge range and documented roof material. Tile roofs use an original ridge along the longest footprint axis; exact ridge geometry and window/balcony modules are estimates, not surveyclaims. Unclassified roofing is neutral rather than inventedterracotta.
source_diagnosis: Exact recorded-camera ray from native860m hits the gray Runoff backdrop at43.74458089N7.42189114E,z190.145m with nearestretainedbuilding285m away; actual Beausoleil city was not retained. This source fills only that bounded urban district.

vegetation.source_method: Official IGN BDTopo orthophotographic vegetation polygons,2022creation,3m planimetric precision. Full exact polygons retained and clipped only at rendering against existingterrainbounds, buildingfootprints, roads and water. Reconstructed individualtrees are not claimed surveyed.

fairmont.registration: Subtract the existing RGE relative datum from actual dominant roof33.9mabsolute; retain existing tunnel-clearing hotel-base elevation.
